name: Wabi-Sabi Web
summary: Muted earth tones, rough textures, uneven edges, much quiet space and small, calm type. It finds beauty in what is imperfect, old and incomplete, and it is the slow side of minimal design.

philosophy.core_thesis: Imperfection is beauty: a worn, quiet surface shows time and honest craft.
design_principles: Use a ground of unbleached tones (#EAE4D8, #D9D1C1) and text in a warm charcoal (#3B3833); keep the palette to 4 muted colours at 10% to 35% saturation.
Add paper, plaster or clay texture at 4% to 10% opacity and let tone vary by 3% to 6% across a surface.
Leave 55% to 75% of each screen empty and place 1 focal item off-centre by 8% to 15%.
Set headings in a calm serif or a light sans at weight 300 to 400, size 28px to 56px, with tracking of +0.02em to +0.08em.
Round edges unevenly: use radii of 2px, 6px, 14px and 4px on the four corners of an image or shape.
Cut borders: use a 1px line at 20% opacity or none; mark the sections with 96px to 160px of space.
Animate slowly: fades of 800ms to 1200ms; one motion at a time.
anti_patterns: Sharp perfect geometry with no texture

layout.grid_mechanics: An asymmetric layout on a 12-column base; items sit off-centre and use only 2 to 4 columns of the width; long gaps divide the sections.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 55% to 75% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 16, 32, 64, 128 and 192px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left, with a ragged edge; vertical text in one place; centred only a single item.
layout.container_geometry: Uneven soft corners; irregular stone, ceramic and torn-paper silhouettes; thin 1px lines at 20%.

font_pairings.note: A calm mincho with a brush-like softness.
A light serif for Latin headings.
A plain, quiet sans for body text.

hierarchy_rules: Set vertical text with `writing-mode: vertical-rl` for one short phrase.

color.palette_structure: Unbleached earth: clay, stone, moss, charcoal.
color.contrast_rules: Charcoal on washi holds 10:1; stone holds at least 4.5:1; moss and rust mark one item per screen.
color.surface_treatment: Matte, uneven fields with paper or plaster texture at 4% to 10%.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft and low: 0 6px 20px at 8% in a warm grey; no hard edge.

materiality.surface_simulation: Plaster, handmade paper, raw ceramic and aged wood.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px line at 20% or no border; edges slightly uneven.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a soft shadow of 0 6px 20px at 8%; one elevation level.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Fine 1.25px icons with round caps in charcoal; small, rare and often replaced by text.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Ceramics, stone, dried branches, plaster walls, linen and hand-made objects in soft light.

motion.transition_physics: Slow and calm: fades of 800ms to 1200ms; items drift 8px; one thing moves at a time.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the opacity of an image from 90% to 100% and underlines text with a 1px line in 600ms; active state dims it by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels slowed down and at ease with what is simple and worn.

avoid_when: The page needs conversion pressure and urgency.
The product has many features to list.

modifiers.how: Set a strict 12-column grid, a neo-grotesque and a single red accent.
Lighten to pastels, add haze and a glow.
Add terracotta, arches and a script accent.

pack.why: A fine, calm line that adds little weight to a quiet page.

ground.why: Wabi-sabi prefers the uneven grain of washi and clay to a clean surface.
